biography: Cavan Corocan's journey began not on the asphalt, but on the windswept shores of Cornwall, where he honed his reflexes navigating treacherous coastal paths on a battered motorbike. The thrill of controlled chaos ignited a fire, leading him to karting at 16. A defining moment came during a local karting championship: down on power, he audaciously out-braked three rivals into the final corner, snatching victory and earning the moniker "Cornwall Comet". After a brief stint in Formula Ford, Cavan struggled with consistency, a raw talent often overshadowed by erratic performances. He found a home in Formula Trainer Advance, where he currently races for the Formula Trainer Advance team, showing flashes of brilliance, but still searching for the stability to truly contend for a championship. His inconsistency is both his greatest strength and weakness, a constant battle against his own nature.
drivingStyle: Corocan's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He attacks corners with a late-braking, aggressive entry, often pushing the limits of grip. Tire management is not his forte; he tends to overdrive the car early in a stint, sacrificing longevity for immediate pace. Under pressure, Cavan can either rise to the occasion with a stunning display of skill or crumble under the weight, making him an unpredictable force on the track. His raw speed is undeniable, but his racecraft and consistency remain works in progress.
rivalries: Marco Bellini: A clash of styles. Bellini, known for his clinical precision, often criticizes Corocan's reckless abandon, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.

Anya Petrova: A battle of wills. Petrova and Corocan have a history of on-track incidents, with neither willing to yield an inch. Their rivalry is fueled by mutual respect and a burning desire to prove themselves superior.
Kenji Tanaka: Tanaka is Cavan's teammate, and the two are constantly battling for position and respect within the team. This has created some tension between the pair.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks (unwashed) for every race weekend.
Has a pre-race ritual of listening to a specific obscure Cornish folk song on repeat.
Refuses to walk under ladders, even in the paddock.
famousQuote: "Sometimes you just have to send it. Worry about the consequences later."
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Trainer Advance race at Silverstone in 2022, overtaking the championship leader on the last lap with a daring move around the outside of Brooklands.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the final round of the Formula Ford championship in 2018, costing him the title.
